message.content: Retrieval is the process of accessing stored information when needed. In artificial intelligence, hybrid retrieval techniques that combine dense vector search with sparse BM25 and cross-encoder reranking are being developed to improve performance. Current large language model agents often employ inefficient retrieval strategies, such as re-reading previously encountered files, without adapting to task complexity.
